title: Umzimba nengqondo
description: Ten short stories about the body and the mind: an old man in a Pietermaritzburg hospital ward, a young boxer in KwaMashu who learns that fear is not cowardice, a keeper who checks the animals' bodies at the Pretoria zoo, a student who meets a python in Hluhluwe and calms her body with her mind, a nervous bride in Eshowe and her bridesmaid, a Pinetown man's diary of eating well and losing weight, a sculptor in Ulundi who carves her great-grandfather the warrior, a Durban woman who learns to greet in Swahili in Zanzibar, a schoolgirl's essay on the human body in space, and a Bergville couple's long wait for their first baby.

lessons.title: UMkhulu Gwala ewodini
lessons.summary: In Pietermaritzburg, seventy-year-old Bongumusa Gwala, who has been coughing up sputum for two months and limps on his left leg, is kept in a hospital ward: Dr Myeza examines him and does not yet know whether it is cancer, nurse Nokulunga cares for him gently, brings him a soft pillow to rest his head on and gives him an injection with a small needle, the tests show no cancer but a small chest illness, and day by day his condition improves until he walks out of the ward without limping.
lessons.text:
UMkhulu Bongumusa Gwala uneminyaka engamashumi ayisikhombisa. Uhlala eMgungundlovu nendodakazi yakhe. Sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili ekhwehlela. Njalo uma ekhwehlela kuphuma isikhwehlela esiningi. Futhi umlenze wakhe wesobunxele ubuhlungu, ngakho uyaxhuga uma ehamba. Indodakazi yakhe iyakhathazeka. Ithi: "Baba, akukuhle ukuxhuga nokukhwehlela kanje. Kumele siye esibhedlela."

Esibhedlela uDokotela Myeza uyampopola. Ulalela isifuba sakhe, abheke umlenze wakhe, abheke nesikhwehlela sakhe. Bese ethi: "Mkhulu, ngifuna ukukupopola kahle. Uzohlala ewodini izinsuku ezimbalwa." UMkhulu Gwala uyesaba. Uthi: "Dokotela, nginomhlaza na?" UDokotela Myeza uthi: "Angazi okwamanje. Umhlaza ungenye yezinto esizozihlola. Ungesabi, Mkhulu."

Iwodi linemibhede eyisithupha. Emibhedeni kulele amadoda amahlanu amadala. Umsebenzi wewodi onakekela abagulayo nguNokulunga. UNokulunga uyabatatamisa bonke abantu abagulayo ewodini. Uyamtatamisa noMkhulu Gwala. Uyamsiza ukuthi ahambe ngoba uyaxhuga, amphathe kahle njengengane encane.

Ebusuku uMkhulu Gwala akakwazi ukulala. Ikhanda lakhe liphansi kakhulu embhedeni. UNokulunga umlethela umqamelo omkhulu othambile. Uthi: "Mkhulu, qamela lo mqamelo." UMkhulu uqamela umqamelo, bese elala kahle. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, ntombazane yami. Lo mqamelo mnandi kunowami ekhaya."

Ngakusasa uNokulunga ufika nenalithi. UMkhulu Gwala akayithandi inalithi. Uthi: "Hhayi, ntombazane, ngiyayesaba inalithi!" UNokulunga uyahleka. Uthi: "Mkhulu, inalithi yami incane kakhulu. Ngizokutatamisa." Uyamhlaba ngenalithi kancane kancane. UMkhulu uthi: "Hawu, angizwanga lutho!"

Izinsuku ezintathu uDokotela Myeza uyampopola njalo ekuseni. Uhlola igazi lakhe nesikhwehlela sakhe. Ngosuku lwesine uthi: "Mkhulu, nginezindaba ezinhle. Awunawo umhlaza. Unesifo esincane sesifuba. Imithi izosiqeda." UMkhulu Gwala uyajabula kakhulu. Uqamela umqamelo wakhe, avale amehlo, athandaze.

Njalo ekuseni uNokulunga uyambuza: "Mkhulu, bunjani ubunjani bakho namuhla?" UMkhulu uthi: "Ubunjani bami bungcono kunezolo." Isikhwehlela siyancipha, nomlenze uyaphola.

Ngemva kwesonto uDokotela Myeza uthi ubunjani bakhe buhle. Angabuyela ekhaya. Indodakazi yakhe iyafika. UMkhulu uphuma ewodini ehamba yedwa. Akaxhugi. Uthi kuNokulunga: "Ngiyabonga ngokungitatamisa. Ngizowukhumbula umqamelo wakho!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMkhulu Gwala eya esibhedlela?
Uya esibhedlela ngoba ukhwehlela isikhwehlela esiningi futhi uyaxhuga.
UDokotela Myeza wenzani esibhedlela?
Uyampopola, futhi uthi uMkhulu uzohlala ewodini izinsuku ezimbalwa.
UNokulunga umlethelani uMkhulu ebusuku?
Umlethela umqamelo omkhulu othambile.
UMkhulu Gwala unomhlaza na?
Cha, akanawo umhlaza. Unesifo esincane sesifuba.
UMkhulu uphuma kanjani ewodini?
Uphuma ehamba yedwa, futhi akaxhugi.

lessons.title: Isilwi saseKwaMashu
lessons.summary: In KwaMashu, nineteen-year-old Thembani Mbatha, a broad-shouldered young man, trains every evening with the boxing coach Luthuli: the boxers train bare-chested, Luthuli's whistle tells them when to run and when to stop, sweat drips from Thembani's face, and he punches the palms of his coach's hands; before his first fight he fears that people will call him a coward, but Luthuli tells him that fear does not make a man a coward, and with his mother sitting at the front of the hall Thembani hurries, punches well and wins.
lessons.text:
UThembani Mbatha uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye. Uhlala eKwaMashu nomama wakhe. UThembani uyisiphika: amahlombe akhe abanzi kakhulu, futhi umzimba wakhe uqinile. Kodwa akazange alwe nomuntu ngaphambili. Ufuna ukuba yisilwi esikhulu.

Njalo kusihlwa uThembani uya ehholo likaLuthuli. ULuthuli ngumqeqeshi wezilwi. Ehholo zonke izilwi ziyaqimba. Zikhumula amahembe azo, ziqeqeshe zingagqokile lutho phezulu. NoThembani uyaqimba. Uthi: "Ukuqimba kuhle, ngoba umzimba awushisi kakhulu."

ULuthuli unempempe entanyeni. Uma eshaya impempe kanye, izilwi ziyagijima. Uma eshaya impempe kabili, ziyema. ULuthuli uthi: "Khawuleza, Thembani! Gijima! Khawuleza!" UThembani uyakhawuleza. Umjuluko uqathaka ebusweni bakhe. Uqathaka phansi njengamanzi emvula.

Bese uLuthuli evula izandla zakhe. Ukhweshe lwesandla sakhe lukhulu futhi luqinile. Uthi: "Bhakela ukhweshe lwami, Thembani! Bhakela ukhweshe lwesokunene, bese ubhakela ukhweshe lwesobunxele!" UThembani ubhakela ukhweshe lukaLuthuli ngamandla. ULuthuli uthi: "Kuhle! Kodwa khawuleza! Isilwi esihle siyakhawuleza."

Ngelinye ilanga uLuthuli uthi: "Thembani, ngoMgqibelo kumele ulwe nesilwi saseMlazi. Lesi silwi silwile izikhathi eziningi." UThembani uyesaba. Ebusuku akalali kahle. Ucabanga: "Uma ngesaba, abantu bazothi ngiyivaka." Ekuseni utshela uLuthuli. ULuthuli uthi: "Thembani, ukwesaba akusho ukuthi uyivaka. Ivaka ngumuntu obalekayo. Isilwi siyesaba naso, kodwa asibaleki."

NgoMgqibelo ihholo ligcwele abantu. Umama kaThembani uhlala komphambili wehholo. Uhlala ngomphambili ukuze abone kahle. Izilwi ezimbili ziyaqimba, zingene phakathi. Umuntu ophethe umdlalo ushaya impempe.

Isilwi saseMlazi sikhulu futhi sinamandla. Simbhakela uThembani esifubeni. UThembani uyesaba, futhi umjuluko uqathaka emehlweni akhe. Kodwa akabaleki. Ukhumbula amazwi kaLuthuli: "Isilwi esihle siyakhawuleza." UThembani uyakhawuleza. Ubhakela isilwi saseMlazi kabili esifubeni, bese esibhakela esilevini. Isilwi saseMlazi siwa phansi, singavuki.

Umuntu ophethe umdlalo ushaya impempe. UThembani uyanqoba! Umama wakhe uyasukuma komphambili wehholo, ajabule kakhulu. ULuthuli uthi: "Thembani, manje uyisilwi sangempela. Awusona isiphika kuphela!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani kuthiwa uThembani uyisiphika?
Kuthiwa uyisiphika ngoba amahlombe akhe abanzi kakhulu.
Izilwi zenzani ehholo likaLuthuli?
Ziyaqimba, ziqeqeshe zingagqokile lutho phezulu.
Kwenzekani uma uLuthuli eshaya impempe kabili?
Izilwi ziyema.
ULuthuli uthi ivaka ngubani?
Uthi ivaka ngumuntu obalekayo.
Umama kaThembani uhlala kuphi ngoMgqibelo?
Uhlala komphambili wehholo ukuze abone kahle.
UThembani unqoba kanjani?
Uyakhawuleza, abhakele isilwi saseMlazi esifubeni nasesilevini.

lessons.title: Usuku lukaSabelo ezu
lessons.summary: Sabelo Khuzwayo works as a keeper at the zoo in Pretoria, and every morning he checks the bodies of the animals: he counts the black and white stripes of a young zebra, watches a cheetah run, lets a porcupine out of its cage, explains to schoolchildren that the flamingos get the redness of their feathers from their food, finds that the old lion is not eating because of a sore tooth and calls the vet, and at night he looks into the cage of a bushbaby, whose big eyes see well in the dark.
lessons.text:
USabelo Khuzwayo usebenza ezu lasePitoli. Izu yindawo lapho abantu beza khona ukubona izilwane zasendle. Izilwane eziningi zezu azihlali emakhejini. Zihlala ezindaweni ezinkulu ezinocingo. Izilwane ezincane kuphela zihlala emakhejini. Umsebenzi kaSabelo ukubheka imizimba yezilwane njalo ekuseni. Uthi: "Umzimba wesilwane uyakutshela konke. Kumele uwubheke kahle."

Ekuseni uSabelo uqala ngedube elincane. Idube lifana nehhashi, kodwa linemidwa. Imidwa yalo emnyama futhi emhlophe. USabelo uyayibala imidwa yedube. Uthi: "Idube ngalinye linemidwa yalo. Awekho amadube amabili anemidwa efanayo." Idube elincane ligijima kahle. Umzimba walo uphilile.

Bese uSabelo eya engululeni. Ingulule yisilwane esigijima ngokushesha kunazo zonke izilwane emhlabeni. Ingulule inamabala amancane amnyama emzimbeni wayo, hhayi imidwa. USabelo ubuka ingulule igijima. Imilenze yayo iqinile. Uthi: "Le ngulule iphilile."

Emva kwalokho uSabelo uvula ikheji lengungumbane. Ingungumbane inameva amade emhlane wayo. Uma yesaba, iphakamisa ameva ayo. USabelo uvula ikheji kancane kancane. Ingungumbane iphuma ekhejini, idle izithelo. USabelo uthi: "Ngiyayithanda ingungumbane, kodwa angiyithinti!"

Eduze kwamanzi kukhona onondwebu abaningi. Unondwebu yinyoni enemilenze emide nentamo ende. Izimpaphe zikanondwebu zibomvu kancane. Izingane zesikole zibuza uSabelo: "Ububomvu bukanondwebu buvelaphi?" USabelo uthi: "Ububomvu buvela ekudleni. Unondwebu udla izilwane ezincane zasemanzini ezibomvu. Uma unondwebu engazidli, ububomvu bezimpaphe zakhe buyaphela."

Emini uSabelo uya embubeni endala. Imbube ihlezi ngaphansi komthunzi. Ayidli inyama yayo. USabelo uyakhathazeka. Ubheka umlomo wembube kahle. Ubona ukuthi elinye izinyo layo libuhlungu. USabelo ushayela udokotela wezilwane ucingo. Udokotela uyafika, asize imbube. Kusihlwa imbube idla inyama yayo yonke.

Ebusuku uSabelo uya ekhejini lesinkwe. Isinkwe yisilwane esincane esinamehlo amakhulu kakhulu. Isinkwe silala emini, sivuke ebusuku. Amehlo aso amakhulu abona kahle ebumnyameni. Isinkwe sigxuma emthini. USabelo uthi: "Lala kahle, sinkwe. Kusasa ngizophinda ngibheke umzimba wakho."

Imibuzo:
USabelo usebenzaphi?
Usebenza ezu lasePitoli.
Kungani kungekho amadube amabili afanayo?
Ngoba idube ngalinye linemidwa yalo.
Ingungumbane yenzani uma yesaba?
Iphakamisa ameva ayo amade.
Ububomvu bukanondwebu buvelaphi?
Buvela ekudleni, ezilwaneni ezincane zasemanzini ezibomvu.
Kungani imbube endala ingadli?
Ngoba elinye izinyo layo libuhlungu.
Kungani isinkwe sibona kahle ebusuku?
Ngoba sinamehlo amakhulu kakhulu.

lessons.title: UNokubonga nenhlwathi
lessons.summary: Student Nokubonga goes on a morning walk in the Hluhluwe game reserve with the ranger Nene, although she is very afraid of snakes: they hear a fish eagle cry over the river, see a hawk catch a partridge, find the holes an aardvark digs at night, watch a lizard on a hot stone and a monitor lizard by the water, and Nene tells how a honey badger furiously attacks bees and even lions for honeycomb; when they meet a python lying in the sun, Nene teaches her to breathe slowly and stand still, and Nokubonga finds that her mind can calm her body.
lessons.text:
UNokubonga ungumfundi omdala. Ufunda ngezilwane zasendle, ngoba ufuna ukusebenza nezilwane. Kodwa uNokubonga unenkinga eyodwa: uyazesaba kakhulu izinyoka. Uma ebona inyoka, inhliziyo yakhe ishaya ngamandla futhi izandla zakhe ziyaqhaqhazela.

Ngelinye ilanga uNokubonga uya eHluhluwe. Uhamba ngezinyawo noNene. UNene usebenza eHluhluwe iminyaka eminingi, futhi uyazazi kahle zonke izilwane zalapho. UNene uthi: "Uma sihamba kumele sithule. Sizolalela izinyoni, futhi sizobona izilwane eziningi."

Eduze komfula bezwa izwi eliphezulu. UNene uthi: "Leyo yinkwazi." Inkwazi yinyoni enkulu enekhanda elimhlophe. Inkwazi ihlala eduze kwamanzi, futhi idla izinhlanzi. Inkwazi iyandiza phezu komfula, ibambe inhlanzi ngezinyawo zayo.

Bese bebona uhele esibhakabhakeni. Uhele lundiza kancane, lubheke phansi. Phansi otshanini kukhona inkwali. Inkwali yinyoni enomzimba omkhulu nemilenze emifushane. Uhele lwehla ngokushesha, lubambe inkwali. UNokubonga uthi: "Inkwali empofu!" UNene uthi: "Uhele kumele ludle nalo."

Phambili bafika emigodini emikhulu. UNene uthi: "Le migodi yenziwe yisambane. Isambane yisilwane esimba ebusuku. Sidla izilwane ezincane kakhulu ezihlala emhlabathini. Emini isambane silala emgodini waso." UNokubonga akasibonanga isambane, kodwa ubona imigodi yaso.

Phezu kwetshe elishisayo kukhona intulo encane. Intulo ilala elangeni ukuze umzimba wayo ufudumale. Eduze kwamanzi kukhona uxamu omkhulu. Uxamu ufana nentulo, kodwa mkhulu kakhulu kunayo. Uxamu ubhukuda emfuleni.

UNene uthi: "Lapha kuhlala nensele. Insele yisilwane esincane, kodwa asesabi lutho. Insele iyathanda ikhekheba lezinyosi. Uma ifuna ikhekheba, iyazingqofa izinyosi. Iyangqofa ngisho nembube, uma imbube iyithinta."

Bese uNene uyema. Uthi: "Thula, Nokubonga. Bheka phambili." Endleleni kulele inhlwathi enkulu. Inhlwathi yinyoka ende kakhulu. Ilele elangeni. Inhliziyo kaNokubonga ishaya ngamandla. UNene uthi: "Ungabaleki. Phefumula kancane. Inhlwathi ayikufuni wena. Ifuna ilanga kuphela."

UNokubonga uyaphefumula kancane kancane. Inhliziyo yakhe iyathula. Inhlwathi iyahamba, ingene otshanini. UNokubonga uthi: "Ngiyibonile inhlwathi, futhi angibalekanga!" UNene uthi: "Ingqondo yakho iqinile. Ingqondo ingawuthulisa umzimba."

Imibuzo:
Iyini inkinga kaNokubonga?
Uyazesaba kakhulu izinyoka.
Uhele lubambani?
Lubamba inkwali otshanini.
Isambane senzani ebusuku?
Siyamba imigodi, futhi sidla izilwane ezincane kakhulu.
Kungani insele iyazingqofa izinyosi?
Ngoba ifuna ikhekheba lezinyosi.
UNene uthi uNokubonga kumele enzeni lapho ebona inhlwathi?
Uthi angabaleki, kodwa aphefumule kancane.

lessons.title: Umshado kaSnothando
lessons.summary: In Eshowe, Snothando is nervous on the morning of her wedding to Sakhiwo Gumbi, and her friend Mandisa, her chief bridesmaid, helps her calm down: a hairdresser does her hair, Mandisa helps her into a white dress and sprays a little perfume, they tie a white ribbon around her bunch of flowers, Snothando remembers how she chose Sakhiwo when she was young and Mandisa tells her it was a good choice, Sakhiwo's friends joke that his bachelorhood is over, and after the ceremony Snothando's mother-in-law places the headdress of a married woman on her head.
lessons.text:
Namuhla nguMgqibelo. USnothando uzoshada noSakhiwo Gumbi eShowe. Ekuseni uSnothando uvuka ngovalo. Inhliziyo yakhe ishaya ngamandla, futhi akakwazi ukudla. Uthi: "Ngiyesaba. Kuthiwani uma ngiwa ngaphambi kwabantu bonke?"

Umngane wakhe omkhulu, uMandisa, uyimpelesi yakhe. Kukhona nezinye izimpelesi ezintathu, kodwa uMandisa uyimpelesi yokuqala. Umsebenzi wempelesi ukusiza intombi eshadayo ngosuku lwayo. UMandisa uthi: "Snothando, phefumula kancane. Namuhla wusuku lwakho. Thina, izimpelesi zakho, sikhona."

Ihora lesishiyagalombili kufika umcwali. Umcwali ngumuntu olungisa izinwele zabantu. Umcwali uhlala noSnothando ihora lonke. Ulungisa izinwele zakhe kahle kakhulu. USnothando ubheka izinwele zakhe. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mcwali. Izinwele zami zinhle kunakuqala."

Bese uMandisa ethatha ilokwe. Ilokwe likaSnothando limhlophe futhi lide. UMandisa umsiza ukuthi agqoke ilokwe. Bese emfaka isiqholo esincane entanyeni. Isiqholo sinuka kamnandi njengezimbali. USnothando uthi: "Ngiyasithanda kakhulu isiqholo sakho. Manje angisesabi kakhulu."

Izimpelesi zinika uSnothando isihla sezimbali ezimhlophe. Isihla sizungezwe yidweshu elimhlophe. UMandisa ulungisa idweshu, aliqinise kahle. Uthi: "Manje isihla sakho silungile."

USnothando ubheka isihla sakhe. Ukhumbula uSakhiwo. Uthi: "Mandisa, uyakhumbula ukuthi ngamqoma kanjani uSakhiwo? Sasifunda esikoleni esisodwa. Wangibhalela izincwadi ezinde iminyaka emibili. Ekugcineni ngamtshela ukuthi ngiyamthanda." UMandisa uthi: "Ngiyakhumbula. Ukuqoma kwakho kwakukuhle. USakhiwo ngumuntu olungile."

Esontweni uSakhiwo umile phambili nabangane bakhe. Abangane bakhe bayahleka. Omunye uthi: "Sakhiwo, namuhla ubumpohlo bakho buyaphela!" Omunye uthi: "Usuku lokugcina lobumpohlo bakho!" USakhiwo uyahleka naye. Uthi: "Ubumpohlo bami bebumnandi, kodwa manje ngifuna ukushada noSnothando. Ngiyamthanda kakhulu."

USnothando ungena esontweni nezimpelesi zakhe. Akawi. Uhamba kahle, ephethe isihla sakhe. Ngemva komshado, umama kaSakhiwo ubekela uSnothando isicholo ekhanda. Isicholo siyisigqoko esikhulu esibomvu sabesifazane abashadile. Umama kaSakhiwo uthi: "Manje uyingxenye yomndeni wethu." USnothando ubamba isicholo sakhe, ajabule.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uSnothando evuka ngovalo?
Uvuka ngovalo ngoba uyesaba ukuwa ngaphambi kwabantu bonke.
Umcwali wenzani?
Ulungisa izinwele zikaSnothando kahle kakhulu.
Isihla sikaSnothando sizungezwe yini?
Sizungezwe yidweshu elimhlophe.
UMandisa uthini ngokuqoma kukaSnothando?
Uthi ukuqoma kwakhe kwakukuhle, ngoba uSakhiwo ngumuntu olungile.
Abangane bakaSakhiwo bathini?
Bathi namuhla ubumpohlo bakhe buyaphela.
Umama kaSakhiwo ubekelani uSnothando ekhanda?
Umbekela isicholo, isigqoko esikhulu esibomvu sabesifazane abashadile.

lessons.title: Incwadi yansuku zonke kaNkosana
lessons.summary: In his diary, Nkosana from Pinetown writes how he changed the way he eats after the doctor warned him about his weight: people used to call him a fat man, he ate fried vetkoek for breakfast every morning, but now his wife Bongiwe cooks him boiled eggs and fruit, he puts less salt in his food, drinks ginger tea and water from a jug, takes samp and beans to work in a lunch box instead of buying fried lunch, and after three months the scale shows that his weight has gone down by ten kilograms.
lessons.text:
NgoMsombuluko, uMashi
Igama lami nguNkosana. Ngineminyaka engamashumi amane. Namuhla ngiye kudokotela. Udokotela ungikalile, wabheka isinzima sami. Uthe: "Nkosana, isinzima sakho siphezulu kakhulu. Kumele usinciphise." Ngidabukile. Abantu emsebenzini bangibiza ngokuthi isidudla. Isidudla ngumuntu onomzimba omkhulu kakhulu, onesinzima esiphezulu. Lelo gama alilihle, futhi liyangidabukisa. Abantu bayahleka, nami ngiyahleka, kodwa enhliziyweni angijabuli. Angifuni ukuba yisidudla.

NgoLwesibili
Njalo ekuseni ibhulakufesi lami lalingamagwinya amathathu. Igwinya limnandi, kodwa liyathoswa emafutheni amaningi. Namuhla umfazi wami uBongiwe ungiphekele ibhulakufesi elisha: amaqanda amabili abilisiwe nesithelo. Ngikhumbule amagwinya ami. Kodwa uBongiwe uthe: "Igwinya elilodwa ngeSonto kuphela."

NgoLwesithathu
Udokotela uthe ngidla itswayi eliningi kakhulu. Itswayi eliningi alilungile enhliziyweni. Ngaphambili ngangifaka itswayi kukho konke ukudla. Namuhla uBongiwe ufake itswayi elincane enyameni, kodwa wafaka nojinja. Ujinja unuka kamnandi futhi uyashisa emlonyeni. Kusihlwa ngiphuze itiye lojinja. Itiye lojinja limnandi kunetiye elinoshukela.

NgoLwesine
Emsebenzini ngangithenga ilantshi esitolo. Ilantshi yami yayihlale iyinyama ethosiwe namazambane athosiwe. Manje uBongiwe ungiphekela ilantshi ekhaya. Ufaka ilantshi yami ethungeni. Namuhla ithunga lami beligcwele isitambu nobhontshisi. Isitambu simnandi, futhi siyasutha isikhathi eside. Abangane bami babheka ithunga lami, bathi: "Nkosana, uyafunda ukudla kahle!"

NgoLwesihlanu
Udokotela uthe kumele ngiphuze amanzi amaningi nsuku zonke, ngoba umzimba uyawadinga amanzi. Etafuleni lami lomsebenzi ngibeka ujeke omkhulu wamanzi. Ujeke wami uthatha amalitha amabili. Njalo kusihlwa ujeke wami awunamanzi, ngoba ngiwaphuzile wonke. Angisaphuzi izinto ezinoshukela.

Ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu
Namuhla ngibuyele kudokotela. Ungikalile futhi. Isinzima sami sehle ngamakhilogremu ayishumi! Udokotela uthe: "Nkosana, wenze kahle kakhulu." Emsebenzini akekho osangibiza ngokuthi isidudla. Ngebhulakufesi ngidla amaqanda nesithelo njalo, ilantshi yami isaphekwa ekhaya, nojeke wami usagcwele amanzi. Kusasa yiSonto. Ngizodla igwinya elilodwa!

Imibuzo:
Udokotela uthini ngesinzima sikaNkosana?
Uthi isinzima sakhe siphezulu kakhulu, futhi kumele asinciphise.
UNkosana wayedlani ngebhulakufesi ngaphambili?
Wayedla amagwinya amathathu.
Kungani itswayi eliningi lingalungile?
Ngoba itswayi eliningi alilungile enhliziyweni.
UNkosana uthwala ilantshi yakhe ngani?
Uyithwala ngethunga, futhi ithunga ligcwele isitambu nobhontshisi.
Ujeke kaNkosana uthatha amalitha amangaki?
Uthatha amalitha amabili.
Isinzima sikaNkosana sehle ngamakhilogremu amangaki?
Sehle ngamakhilogremu ayishumi.

lessons.title: Izithombe zikaSinethemba
lessons.summary: At a museum in Ulundi, the sculptor Sinethemba Sikhakhane shows a class of schoolchildren the wooden statues she has carved: her great-grandfather as a young warrior with a short stabbing spear and a throwing spear, a small homestead behind a stone rampart, girls in the bead loincloths of the old days, and a woman who rose to the status of a chief's wife; she tells the old family story of a friend who betrayed her great-grandfather's homestead to its enemies, and explains that a sculptor must first carve the picture in her mind before she carves the wood.
lessons.text:
USinethemba Sikhakhane ungumqophi. Umqophi ngumuntu owenza izithombe ngokhuni noma ngetshe. Izithombe zikaSinethemba zibukiswa endlini enkulu oLundi, lapho abantu befunda khona ngezikhathi zakudala. Namuhla kufika izingane zesikole nomfundisi wazo. USinethemba uthi: "Sawubonani, bantwana. Ngiyajabula ukunibona. Wozani nibone izithombe zami."

Isithombe sokuqala yinsizwa ephethe imikhonto emibili. USinethemba uthi: "Lona ngukoko wami. Ukoko ngumzali kamkhulu noma kagogo. Ukoko wami wayeyiqhawe lenkosi." Ingane eyodwa ibuza: "Kungani ephethe imikhonto emibili?" USinethemba uthi: "Umkhonto omfushane yiklwa. Iklwa linomlomo obanzi. Iqhawe lalilwa ngeklwa eduze kwesitha. Umkhonto omude yisijula. Isijula sasijikijelwa kude. Ukoko wami wayejikijela isijula kuqala, bese elwa ngeklwa."

Isithombe sesibili ngumuzi omncane. Umuzi uzungezwe yigoqo lamatshe. USinethemba uthi: "Igoqo lenziwe ngamatshe, njengodonga. Abantu bakudala babakha igoqo ukuze bavikele izinkomo nabantu emzini. Umuzi kakoko wami wawunegoqo njengaleli."

Bese uSinethemba ekhomba izithombe zamantombazane amancane. Uthi: "Bhekani abantwana labaya. Bangamantombazane amancane, futhi bagqoke izigege. Isigege yingubo encane yamantombazane, eyenziwe ngobuhlalu. Ezikhathini zakudala amantombazane ayegqoka isigege, ikakhulukazi uma esina. Abantwana labaya bayasina."

Isithombe sokugcina ngowesifazane omude. Ugqoke izingubo ezinhle. USinethemba uthi: "Lona ngowesifazane wakudala owathola ubukhosikazi. Wayeyintombazane yasemakhaya, kodwa inkosi yamqoma. Ngenxa yobukhosikazi bakhe, bonke abantu bamhlonipha. Kodwa ubukhosikazi babuletha nomsebenzi omningi."

Ingane ibuza: "Ukoko wakho wafa kanjani?" USinethemba uthi: "Akafanga empini. Kodwa kunendaba endala emndenini wethu. Umngane kakoko wamchilizela ukoko wami. Watshela izitha ukuthi umuzi kakoko ukuphi. Izitha zafika ebusuku. Kodwa igoqo lamatshe lasiza abantu, futhi ukoko wami walwa ngeklwa lakhe. Abantu bomuzi basinda. Ngemva kwalokho akekho owaphinda wamthemba umngane owamchilizela ukoko."

Umfundisi ubuza: "Sinethemba, umqophi uqala ngani?" USinethemba uthi: "Umqophi uqala engqondweni. Ngiqala ngibone isithombe engqondweni yami. Bese ngiqopha ukhuni. Uma isithombe singekho engqondweni, asikho nasekhunini."

Imibuzo:
Umqophi ngubani?
Umqophi ngumuntu owenza izithombe ngokhuni noma ngetshe.
Ukoko kaSinethemba uphethe imikhonto emibili enjani?
Uphethe iklwa elifushane nesijula eside.
Igoqo lalenzelwani?
Lalenzelwa ukuvikela izinkomo nabantu emzini.
Abantwana labaya bagqokeni?
Bagqoke izigege, izingubo ezincane zobuhlalu.
Umngane kakoko wamchilizela kanjani?
Watshela izitha ukuthi umuzi kakoko ukuphi.
Umqophi uqala kuphi?
Uqala engqondweni, bese eqopha ukhuni.

lessons.title: UNokuthokoza eZanzibar
lessons.summary: Before her holiday in Zanzibar, Nokuthokoza Ngidi from Durban learns from her Swazi neighbour Gogo Magagula how close Swazi is to Zulu, and she worries about her ignorance of Swahili, the language of Zanzibar; on the island she learns to greet people in Swahili, walks through the big bazaar in a light drizzle, watches a man crack open a large hard fruit with a knife, eats octopus cooked by a fisherman for the first time, and takes a boat to a small islet, and she finds that a mind which wants to learn makes ignorance grow smaller every day.
lessons.text:
UNokuthokoza Ngidi uhlala eThekwini. NgoJulayi uzohamba eZanzibar ngamaholide. IZanzibar yisiqhingi esikhulu olwandle, kude enyakatho. Abantu baseZanzibar bakhuluma isiSwahili.

Umakhelwane kaNokuthokoza nguGogo Magagula. UGogo Magagula ukhuluma isiSwazi, ngoba lolo wulimi lwakhe lwasekhaya. UNokuthokoza uyamvakashela, futhi uGogo uthi: "Nokuthokoza, isiSwazi nesiZulu kuyafana kakhulu. Uma ngikhuluma isiSwazi, uyezwa na?" UNokuthokoza uthi: "Yebo, Gogo, ngiyezwa kahle. Kodwa isiSwahili asifani nesiZulu. Angazi lutho ngesiSwahili. Ngiyabesaba ubuluhlaza bami."

UGogo Magagula uthi: "Ubuluhlaza abubi, ntombazane yami. Wonke umuntu uqala ngobuluhlaza. Funda ukubulisa abantu ngesiSwahili kuqala. Uma ubulisa umuntu ngolimi lwakhe, inhliziyo yakhe iyavuleka."

Ngakho uNokuthokoza ufunda isiSwahili ocingweni lwakhe njalo kusihlwa. Ufunda ukubulisa, ukubonga nokubuza intengo. Ubuluhlaza bakhe bunciphile kancane.

EZanzibar uNokuthokoza ubulisa wonke umuntu ngesiSwahili. Ubulisa umuntu wasehhotela, abulise nendoda eshayela imoto. Bonke bayahleka bajabule. Owesifazane othile uthi ngesiNgisi: "Ukhuluma isiSwahili kahle!"

Ekuseni kuyakhiza. Imvula incane kakhulu. Kodwa uNokuthokoza akahlali ehhotela. Uya ebhazeni elikhulu. Ibhaza yindawo enkulu yokuthengisa enezitolo eziningi ezincane. Ebhazeni kunezithelo, izinhlanzi, izingubo nezinto zokupheka. Nakuba kukhiza, abantu abaningi bayathenga.

Ebhazeni uNokuthokoza ubona indoda igqoma isithelo esikhulu esiqinile ngommese omkhulu. Iyasigqoma kabili, bese isithelo sivuleka. Ngaphakathi kunamanzi amnandi. UNokuthokoza uyawaphuza.

Emini indoda edoba izinhlanzi imphekela ingwane. Ingwane yisilwane esiphila olwandle, esinemilenze eyisishiyagalombili. UNokuthokoza akazange adle ingwane ngaphambili. Uyesaba kancane, kodwa uyayidla. Ingwane imnandi kakhulu. UNokuthokoza ubulisa indoda, ayibonge ngesiSwahili. Indoda iyajabula kakhulu.

Ngemva kwalokho uNokuthokoza ugibela isikebhe esincane, aye esiqhinganeni. Isiqhingana siyisiqhingi esincane kakhulu. Esiqhinganeni kunezihlahla ezinkulu nezilwane ezindala. UNokuthokoza uhlala ogwini lwesiqhingana, abheke ulwandle oluhle. Uyaphumula, futhi ingqondo yakhe ithule.

Ebusuku uNokuthokoza ubhalela uGogo Magagula: "Gogo, ngibulise abantu abaningi ngesiSwahili namuhla. Ubuluhlaza bami buyancipha nsuku zonke. Ingqondo efuna ukufunda iqinile."

Imibuzo:
UGogo Magagula ukhuluma luphi ulimi?
Ukhuluma isiSwazi.
Kungani uNokuthokoza esaba?
Uyesaba ngoba akazi lutho ngesiSwahili.
UGogo Magagula uthi uNokuthokoza kumele aqale ngani?
Uthi kumele aqale ngokufunda ukubulisa abantu ngesiSwahili.
Isimo sezulu sinjani ekuseni eZanzibar?
Kuyakhiza, futhi imvula incane kakhulu.
Ibhaza yini?
Yindawo enkulu yokuthengisa enezitolo eziningi ezincane.
Indoda ebhazeni igqoma isithelo ngani?
Isigqoma ngommese omkhulu.
Isiqhingana yini?
Isiqhingana siyisiqhingi esincane kakhulu.

lessons.title: Umzimba emkhathini
lessons.summary: In a school essay, schoolgirl Sanelisiwe Zwide explains why she dreams of travelling to space and what happens to the body there: she watches the moonlight from her yard, describes the Earth as a planet with a layer of air around it, explains that in a spaceship the body loses its weight but keeps its mass, lists the needs of the body in space, tells how astronauts eat food from packets and tie their spanners to the ship, and how they repair the ship when a piece breaks off, and ends by saying that space needs a strong mind as well as a strong body.
lessons.text:
Iphupho lami: umzimba emkhathini
NguSanelisiwe Zwide, umfundi wesikole

Ebusuku ngithanda ukuhlala ngaphandle ngibheke inyanga. Unyezi ukhanyisa igceke lethu, futhi unyezi umhlophe njengobisi. Esikoleni ngafunda ukuthi unyezi awuveli enyangeni ngokwayo. Ilanga likhanyisa inyanga, bese inyanga ibuyisela lokho kukhanya emhlabeni. Uma ngibona unyezi, ngicabanga ngomkhathi. Iphupho lami ukuhamba ngomkhumbimkhathi.

Umhlaba wethu ungunozungezilanga. Unozungezilanga yinto enkulu ezungeza ilanga. Kukhona onozungezilanga abaningi. Abanye bakhulu kunomhlaba, abanye bancane. Umhlaba wethu uzungezwe yiqeqeba lomoya. Iqeqeba lomoya lisivikela elangeni elishisayo, futhi lisinika umoya esiwuphefumulayo. Emkhathini alikho iqeqeba lomoya.

Umzimba womuntu uyashintsha emkhathini. Emhlabeni sinesinzima. Ngaphakathi komkhumbimkhathi umzimba awunaso isinzima. Abantu bandiza ngaphakathi komkhumbimkhathi njengezinyoni. Kodwa umzimba awuyilahli ingqumbi yawo. Ingqumbi yinto yonke eyenza umzimba. Isinzima siyaphela, kodwa ingqumbi ihlala injalo.

Umzimba unezinswelo eziningi emkhathini. Inswelo yokuqala ngumoya. Inswelo yesibili ngamanzi. Inswelo yesithathu ngukudla. Abantu bathwala konke lokhu ngomkhumbimkhathi. Ukudla kwabo kufakwa ezishuqulwini ezincane. Isishuqulu ngasinye sinokudla kosuku olulodwa. Uma udla, uvula isishuqulu kancane, ngoba uma ukudla kuphuma esishuqulwini kuyandiza!

Nezinto ziyandiza ngaphakathi komkhumbimkhathi. Uma umuntu esebenzisa isipanela, kumele asibophe ngentambo. Uma engasibophanga, isipanela siyandiza siye kude. Ngelinye ilanga ngafunda indaba yomuntu owalahlekelwa yisipanela sakhe emkhathini. Isipanela sakhe sazungeza umhlaba isikhathi eside.

Ngezinye izikhathi ingxenye encane yomkhumbimkhathi iyaqhephuka. Uma ingxenye iqhephukile, abantu kumele baphume ngaphandle komkhumbimkhathi, bayilungise. Bagqoka izingubo ezinkulu ezinomoya ngaphakathi, bathathe izipanela zabo. Lo ngumsebenzi onzima, futhi kumele bangesabi.

Ngicabanga ukuthi umkhathi awudingi umzimba oqinile kuphela. Udinga nengqondo eqinile. Ngakho ngifunda kakhulu, ngigijima njalo ekuseni, futhi ngifunda ukungesabi. Ngelinye ilanga ngizobheka unyezi ngaphakathi komkhumbimkhathi, hhayi egcekeni lethu.

Imibuzo:
USanelisiwe ucabanga ngani uma ebona unyezi?
Ucabanga ngomkhathi.
Unozungezilanga yini?
Yinto enkulu ezungeza ilanga.
Iqeqeba lomoya lisisiza kanjani?
Lisivikela elangeni elishisayo, futhi lisinika umoya esiwuphefumulayo.
Kwenzekani esinzimeni nasengqumbini yomzimba emkhathini?
Isinzima siyaphela, kodwa ingqumbi ihlala injalo.
Kungani umuntu kumele abophe isipanela sakhe ngentambo?
Ngoba uma engasibophanga, isipanela siyandiza siye kude.
Abantu benzani uma ingxenye yomkhumbimkhathi iqhephukile?
Baphuma ngaphandle komkhumbimkhathi, bayilungise ngezipanela zabo.

lessons.title: Ubumtoti bokuba ngumama
lessons.summary: In Bergville, Lindelwa and her husband Sibonakaliso wait eight years for a child while some neighbours whisper the hurtful word for a barren woman, until at last a baby girl is born: the baby has soft folds of skin on her fat arms and legs, Sibonakaliso shaves with his razor every morning so that his face is smooth when he kisses her, his mother spoils the baby, the baby whines when she is hungry and Lindelwa learns not to spoil her every time, and Sibonakaliso's brother brings a toy hare and tells the baby the old story of the clever hare, while Lindelwa feels the sweetness of being a mother.
lessons.text:
ULindelwa nomyeni wakhe uSibonakaliso bahlala eBergville. Bashada eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili edlule. Bafuna ingane kakhulu, kodwa ingane ayizi. Abanye abantu emakhelwaneni bayahleba. Bathi uLindelwa uyinyumba. Inyumba ngowesifazane ongakwazi ukuthola ingane. Lelo gama libuhlungu kakhulu kowesifazane. ULindelwa uyakhala ebusuku. USibonakaliso uthi: "Lindelwa, awuyona inyumba. Masilinde. UNkulunkulu uzosinika ingane."

Ngonyaka wesishiyagalolunye uLindelwa uthola ingane yentombazane. Ingane incane, kodwa iyadla kahle. Izingalo zayo zinemivingqi, nemilenze yayo inemivingqi. Umvingqi yisikhumba esigoqekayo emzimbeni. ULindelwa uthanda ukuthinta imivingqi yengane. Uthi: "Bheka lo mvingqi omncane engalweni yayo!" USibonakaliso uyahleka. Uthi: "Imivingqi isho ukuthi ingane iyadla kahle."

Njalo ekuseni uSibonakaliso ugunda intshebe yakhe ngempuco. Ngaphambili wayegunda kabili ngesonto kuphela. Manje usebenzisa impuco nsuku zonke. ULindelwa uyambuza: "Kungani usebenzisa impuco njalo?" Uthi: "Ngoba ngifuna ukwanga ingane yethu. Intshebe yami iyayihlaba. Ubuso bami kumele buthambe njengesikhumba sayo!"

Umama kaSibonakaliso, uGogo, uhlala nabo isikhathi esithile. UGogo uyayiduda ingane. Uyayiphatha njalo, ayicule, ayinike konke ekufunayo. ULindelwa uthi: "Gogo, uyayiduda le ngane!" UGogo uthi: "Ngiyayiduda ngoba ngiyayithanda. Ugogo ngamunye uyamduda umzukulu wakhe."

Uma ingane ilambile, iyatetema. Itetema isikhathi eside, bese ikhala. Ekuqaleni uLindelwa uyayiphatha njalo uma itetema. Kodwa udokotela uthi kuye: "Uma ingane itetema ngoba ilambile, yinike ukudla. Kodwa uma itetema nje, ungayiphathi njalo. Ungayiduda kakhulu." ULindelwa uyafunda.

NgeSonto kufika umlamu kaLindelwa, ubhuti kaSibonakaliso. Ulethela ingane umvundla omncane othambile, wokudlala. Uhlala eduze kwengane, ayixoxele indaba endala yomvundla ohlakaniphile. Uthi: "Umvundla wawumncane, kodwa wawuhlakaniphe kunazo zonke izilwane." Ingane iyalala ibambe umvundla wayo. ULindelwa uthi kumlamu wakhe: "Ngiyabonga, mlamu wami. Ungumlamu omuhle."

Kusihlwa uLindelwa uhlezi nengane yakhe. Ucabanga ngeminyaka yokulinda. Uthi kuSibonakaliso: "Ngangingazi ubumtoti bokuba ngumama. Ubumtoti balokhu bukhulu kunobuhlungu bonke bami." USibonakaliso uthi: "Ubumtoti buyeza emva kokulinda."

Imibuzo:
Abanye abantu emakhelwaneni bathini ngoLindelwa?
Bathi uyinyumba.
Umvingqi yini?
Umvingqi yisikhumba esigoqekayo emzimbeni.
Kungani uSibonakaliso esebenzisa impuco nsuku zonke?
Ngoba ufuna ukwanga ingane, futhi intshebe yakhe iyayihlaba.
UGogo wenzani nengane?
Uyayiduda, ayiphathe njalo, ayinike konke ekufunayo.
Umlamu kaLindelwa ulethelani ingane?
Ulethela ingane umvundla omncane othambile, wokudlala.
